tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// nyang lugs gu ru drag dmar gyi gtor ma'i las mtha' dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dregs pa 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir nyang lugs gu ru drag po'i sgo nas gtor zlog bya ba la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po ni/ rab drag po'i las dang mthun pa'i gnas sam/ de min sgrub khang gi lho phyogs su stegs mtho bar bla ma drag po'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung bsham/ de'i mdun du yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma/ skong gtor rgyas bsdus ci rigs/ de'i mdun du zlog dkyil chos 'byung gru gsum mu ran can/ chos 'byung nang dmar po/ mu ran sngon po/ zla gam khrag mtsho/ mu khyud thod phreng*/ pad 'dab phyogs tshon/ rtsibs sngon po ser po/ gzhi dmar po// rdo rwa me ri spyi mthun no// ma 'byor na zhing lpags la khrag gi sbags pa'i 'bru'i tshom bu lha grangs bkod pas kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang dbus su mañdzi'i khar lcags snod du 'bru nag gi ngar phye dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i dpal gtor gru gsum rno dbal can 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mtshe yungs rtsangs dang*/ khram byang sogs drag rgyan rngams brjid dang ldan pa'i rtser sku rten srung zlog gi tsakra/ dar dmar po'i gur phub pa/ mtha' rdo rwa'i khar gtor zor khrag zor yungs zor rnams phyogs rer tshar re bshams/ de'i mthar g.yas skor du khrag gi ar+ghaṃ sogs drag mchod/ mchod yon gyi rgyab tu rdul tshon gyi 'brub khung rtse lhor phyogs pa'i khar lcags slang ngam lcags snod gru gsum par dgra bgegs kyi liṅga spyi dang mthun pa ling kheb bcas rdo rjes mnan pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍa ma ru/ 'thor nas/ bya 'ug gi sgro/ phur pa bcu gnyis/ ral gri/ tho ba/ nyungs dkar nag ske shang sogs skam thun rlon thun 'thor yab bcas/ khrag chang rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dung chen rkang gling sogs drag rol gyi chas sogs 'du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod pa dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsnyen thabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar gtong zhing*/ brgyud 'debs/ mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems nas brtsams te/ yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ de nas rang zlog dkyil 'khor dbyer med du bsgom pa la/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje sems// pad+ma rgyal po 'di skad gsung*// dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing*// smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che// blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i// de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom// blo bral de yi ngang nas ni// sems can kun la khyab pa yi// brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom// kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin// stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can de// 'gro don dpag med byed pa la// rgyu yi ting 'dzin rang gi sems// hūm̐ gi yi ge dmar por gyur// e yam̐ ra sum̐ kiṃ ram̐ bh+rūm̐// e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gtams// ra las khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil// sum̐ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal// keṃ las keng rus ri rab brtsegs// ram̐ las bskal pa'i me phung 'bar// bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// phyi ni thod rlon bar ni rnying*// skam pos nang byas rtsig pa can// gnam lcags gzer btab gru bzhi pa// sgo bzhir zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar// tshangs pa pho mo'i ka gdung can// zhing lpags thog dang bla bres byas// rgyu ma'i drwa phyed don snying 'phyang*// phyi nang me phung smug nag 'bar// gzhal yas khang pa de yi nang*// 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa// mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas bskor// dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar// zla gam dmar nag gsum dang bcas// gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du// gser gyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor// de rtse sdig pas mtshan pa'o// me yi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor// rtse bsnol bar du dgra bgegs 'joms// de rgyab rdo rje'i gur khang phub// phyi rol ye shes me phung 'bar// dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad bsregs// dbus su pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la// ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/

a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ rāk+ṣa sa ti ra bam̐/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba srin po zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ yig dmar po bsams pa las// phyogs bcur 'od 'phros sangs rgyas kyi// thugs dam rgyud bskul 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las// bdag nyid zil gnon pad+ma'i sku// dmar po me yi phreng bas brgyan// zhal gcig phyag gnyis brkyang bskum bgrad// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas lcags sdig kha dgu bsnams// dbu skra snum 'bol gyen du 'khyil// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas// rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la spras// dbu dang phyag zhabs sbrul gyis brgyan// glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// stag gi pags pa'i 'og pag can// rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// de yi spyi gtsug bya khyung rgyal// mthing nag me yi gshog pa gdengs// gnam lcags thog me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro// de steng pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' yas// sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag can// dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// sku yi ngo bo tshon gang pa// dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i khro gnyer steng*// gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus// 'jam dpal sku mdog gser gyi mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu rgyan can// phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri bsnams// g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad// cung zad khro tshul 'gying bag can// de yi spyi bor yi ge oṃ// gser mdog bdag sku byin gyis brlabs// mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur can// rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su sgrogs// g.yas pas rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar// g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad// brkyang bskum dor stabs bzhugs pa'o// de yi mgrin par yi ge āḥ

/dmar po bdag gsung byin gyis brlabs// thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten ser// ri rab bang rim bum pa bre// 'khor lo tog dang ldan par bsgom// bum par phyag na rdo rje ni// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad// khro gtum drag po brjid pa'i sku// de yi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag /bdag thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/

/'dir sa lugs kyi las byang du/ dag ces pa'i gnyis tshig la dpyad na/ rang gtso bo'i lus la go cha'i lha gsal ba dang lhan cig tu/ lho rtsibs la 'jam dpal/ shar rtsibs la phyag rdor/ nub rtsibs la rta mgrin gsal dgos pa shugs kyis grub ces gsungs shing*/ byang rtsibs la lha gang gsal ma gsungs kyang*/ bya khyung rgyal po yin nam/ yang na khro bo yak+ṣa me dpal spyan drangs nas der bzhugs rgyu gang yin dpyad par zhu/ mchan/ sku yi yi ge oṃ las ni// 'od zer ser po 'phros pa yis// sku yi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas// mdzod spu'i 'jam dpal dag la thim// sku mi shigs rdo rje'i dbang thob gyur// gsung gi snying po āḥlas ni// 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis// gsung gi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas// mgrin pa'i rta mgrin dag la thim// gsung 'gag pa med pa'i dbang thob gyur// thugs kyi yi ge hūm̐ las ni// 'od zer mthing nag 'phros pa yis// thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te// thugs ka'i phyag rdor dag la thim// thugs 'khrul pa med pa'i dbang thob gyur// yi ge gsum las 'od zer gsum// phyogs bcu rnams su 'phros pa yis// rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang*// gzhan yang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*// sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la// snang ba mtha' yas dag la thim// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las la sogs dbang thob gyur// de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas// rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar las// 'od zer nag po grangs med 'phros// hūm̐ nag grangs med 'jig rten khengs// snang srid thams cad gang bar bsam// hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba las// khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal ni// nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas rdung bas tho ba bsnams// sku las bskal pa'i me phung 'bar// de 'dra'i khro bos snang srid khengs// lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs// gnod byed gdon bgegs ma lus pa// 'dar zhing dngangs nas brgyal dang 'bogs// brdung zhing bsregs dang bsad par gyur// de ltar rten dang brten pa'i lha tshogs gsal bar bskyed la sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes pa rnams bstims nas/

mchod 'bul nas bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ khyad par gyi dmigs gnad dang ldan pas rtsa sngags gong ltar brgya rtsa shub bu/ rtsa sngags la a ya ma du ru tsa sha nā sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gnod byed gdon bgegs rgyal 'gong bsen mo dam sri'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sham bu btags pa brgya rtsa dang*/ bha ya nā sa tshar gsum bcas 'ur 'don grub nas/ skam rlon gyi thun rdzas la phu gdab/ de nas/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*// sangs rgyas kyi= /chos kyi= /dge 'dun gyi= /yi dam sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= khyad par du pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang sogs nas/ sha za bar gyur cig bar spyi ltar dang*/ dbang drag 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis sogs nas/ dbyings su sgrol/ rak+ṣa lan gsum dang*/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ de nas yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo ni/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas ram̐ spros sogs nas/ las bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin dang*/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs// longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo la// spyan 'dren mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ tshogs phud phul nas/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar// ma rig dbang gis lus ngag sems// bag med dam las 'gal gyur rnams// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags// badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams drag po'i las la bskul ba ni/ dbyangs rol sogs phyag len bzhin spros te/ snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i rol pa las// bdud 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul skur shar// khams gsum dbang phyug rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// ma rgyud gdul dka' 'dul phyir thugs dam bskul// thugs nyid zhi ba chos kyi dbyings nyid las// ma 'gags rang rtsal khrag 'thung khros pa'i gar// sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar dgu'i dpa' brjid can// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb// nyi zla 'bar ba'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// smin ma ag tshom me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro// kham nag ral pa srid rtse khyab par g.yo// mi bzad 'jigs gzugs rngams pa'i gzi mdangs can// gti mug 'joms phyir glang chen stod g.yogs mdzad// 'dod chags 'joms phyir zhing lpags sked la dkris// phrag dog 'joms phyir gnas gsum byugs pas mtshan// nga rgyal dbang sdud stag pags sham thabs 'chang*// zhe sdang 'joms phyir sbrul gyis yan lag dkris// dregs pa 'dul phyir thod rlon do shal mdzad// 'dod yon ma spangs rin chen du mas spras// phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i phyag rgyas mdzes// mdzes shing dpa' ba'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu las// hūm̐ phaṭa ram̐ sogs rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro// dregs pa dbang sdud gtor sreg phrin las ldan// phyag g.yon gnam lcags phur bu rno ngar 'bar// dregs pa sde brgyad kun gyi snying rtsa sreg /gnod byed 'byung po klad pa 'gems par byed// sdigs mdzub rtse las lcags sdig pho nyar 'gyed// kha dgu mig dgu bco brgyad rwa dang ldan// mi sdug gzugs can drag po'i skan sgra rdeb// rngams pa'i me dpung 'tshubs shing tshwa tshwa 'phro// gnod byed rgyal 'gong srog dbugs rngams zas byed// khro rgyal 'bar ba'i zhabs kyi stang stabs kyis// sa gsum g.yo zhing dregs pa'i gdan la rol// khro rgyal khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ka

/thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya// khro rgyal dbu gtsug mtha' yas khros pa'i khyung*// mthing nag me yi gshog pa g.yob cing rdeb// khro gnyer spyan gsum rdo rje'i mchu sder gyis// zhe sdang gdug pa'i klu rnams zas su gsol// mi 'gyur rdo rje 'bar ba'i ba spu las// sprul pa'i byang khyung mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'gyed// ral gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon las// ye shes me rlung rngams sgra 'brug ltar ldir// de steng rigs bdag chos sku 'od dpag med// dmar gsal sprul sku'i cha byad tshe bum 'dzin// tshe dang ye shes dpag g.yas dngos grub stsol// khrag 'thung thugs srog 'bar ba'i srog gi sgor// thugs nyid zhi las g.yo ba med pa'i phyir// ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// dkar dmar gsang phod snam sbyar za ber gsol// rdo rje thod pa tshe yi bum pa 'dzin// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag /mthu rtsal rmad byung khro rgyal he ru ka /dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal can// thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya// khro rgyal sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las rang rtsal 'gag med rol pa las// gsang bdag gshin rje rta mgrin me dbal dang*// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro phyogs skyong khro bo bcu// pho nya yang sprul nying sprul grangs med 'gyed// rngams brjid skar ltar 'khrugs shing glog ltar 'khyug /'bar ba'i chas can gdug pa'i mtshon cha gdengs// 'khor bcas drag po'i thugs dam dus la bab// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod byed pa'i// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs kyi tshogs// bsad bcad gtubs te rdul du brlag pa dang*// dug gsum sha khrag rus pa tshogs su rol// dbang drag pad+ma bka' yi pho nyar bcas// drag po'i phrin las dam tshig dus la bab// ces gdung ba'i shugs drag pos thugs dam bskul bar bya'o// gnyis pa rngan dbul ba ni/

gser skyems byin gyis brlabs nas 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha// khyad par dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed// ma mgon lcam dral las gshin 'chi bdag sogs// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed// sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhis gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed// ces 'bul/ gsum pa dbang gsol ba ni/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas// bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam lha// khrag 'thung dbang drag 'khor dang bcas// thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// dam tshig 'dzin la dgra byung na// ma nyes ma yo srung ma mkhyen// gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs// zhal ce snang srid lha 'dres chod// dam nyams dgra bo sdig chen 'di// dang po sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig /bar du dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad// tha mar gsang sngags snying po dral// da lta rnal 'byor bdag la bsdos// dge ba bcu ni khyad du bsad// mi dge bcu ni dwang du blangs// mtshams med lnga yi 'bras bu smin// 'di ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin pas// dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs rnams// chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*// rngams brjid khros pa'i skur bzhengs la// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab// ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs dam can// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces mnyes pa'i dpang gzug bzhi pa dmigs bya bskyed pa ni/ liṅga slob dpon gyi mdun du bshams la ling khebs bsal te/ phaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang las e las lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom gru gsum bang rim dgu pa kha khyer dog cing gting zab pa/

'og tu 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba/ logs la zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshubs pa/ steng na gti mug gi mun pa gtibs pa/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs shing nad dang dug gi rlangs pa 'phro ba/ than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs mi bzad par 'khrugs pa/ las byed gshin rje'i dmag tshogs seng ge ltar rngams pa/ stag ltar 'phyo ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyugs pa/ rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pas gang ba/ srid pa las kyi btson khang drag po de'i nang du nṛ tri dud ka yongs su gyur pa las/ dgra bgegs de nyid lus gcer bu rid pa/ mdog nag cing dran pa nyams pa/ mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa/ gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa dmigs shing gsal gdab/ lnga pa rnam shes dgug pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= /chos kyi= /dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin kyi= chos nyid gdod nas stong yang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i= /khyad par che mchog pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi= /bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas/ gar bros kyang skad cig yud lam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khu gcig sgrub sngags a rtsig sham bu bcas pa'i rjes su sarba bigh+nān sha trun ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ tri ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas lan gsum gyis dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ drug pa pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas// che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// drag po'i phrin las dus la bab// mkha' dbyings khyab pa'i pho nya dang*// sprul pa'i dmag tshogs las la 'gyed// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs// gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa kun// zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms// khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus// sod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis// phye shig non cig rmugs par gyis// thul cig choms shig rdul phran bzhin// bdag gi bsgo ba kun nyon la// gzugs brnyan 'di la myur du phob// srung skyob mgon dang bral bar mdzod// ces drag tu bskul lo// bdun pa lha dang dbye ba ni/ dbye rdzas bdugs shing bya 'ug gi sgro thogs la/ hūm̐/ dam nyams dgra bo sdig can la// srung skyob mdzad pa kun nyon cig /sems can las ngan sdig can 'di// bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pas na// 'di la srung skyob ma mdzad par// yal bar thong la ring du spongs// bka' las 'das na khrag 'thung dpal// khros pas khyed nyid gzhom par byed// de bas skyob byed kun dang phrol// gnod byed gshed ma'i bdud dang sprod// rtsa sngags mthar nṛ tri de ba u tsaṭ+ṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod cing sgro gnyis kyis dbye ba'i tshul bya ba ni kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga'o// brgyad pa gnad la dbab pa la lnga/ dang po ni skam thun thogs la/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung khro rgyal drag po'i mtshon// gtum drag pho nyar 'bar ba'i thun// rno myur shugs drag rdo rje'i me// mi bzad mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor ni// gnam sa 'khrugs pa'i thog zer bzhin// dgra bgegs gzugs phung rten la ya// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa trig nan e hur thuṃ dzaḥ

gzir nan kā wā tsi ta rbad rbad/ ces brjod cing bran la rlon thun gyis kyang brab/ gnyis pa phur gdab la gnyis/ dang po thugs rjes rjes 'dzin gyi phur bus brten pa dbyings su bsgral ba ni/ phur bu thal mo'i bar du bzung la sor mo bcu rigs lnga yab yum bcur gyur par bsam/ sa ma ya ho zhes slob dpon gyis bskul bas/ rigs lnga yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i mkha' las sras mchog yak+ṣa me dbal sku stod srin po khros pa'i nyams can phur bu bsgril ba/ lte ba man chad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dbal zur gsum rno ba'i khong seng du lha'i pho brang bcas pa/ rtse mor dregs pa'i dmag tshogs las la rngams shing dus me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha badz+ra kī li kī la ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs phur bu la thim pas khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod/ hūm̐/ dbang drag thugs las sprul pa'i sras// 'jigs byed 'jigs mdzad kī la ya// rno ngar 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon// gzir zhig dgra bo'i snying rtsa la// ye shes chen po mi shigs pa'i// dwang ma bdag gi snying la bstims// las nyon bag chags bcas pa'i gzugs// rdul phran bzhin du bsgral bar bya// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang yang brjod cing*/ phur bu rang gi gnas gsum du bskor ba/ bsgril ba/ 'debs pa/ gnas gsum du reg cing sngags 'don pa/ slar bsgril te btab nas rnam shes spar ba rnams dmigs pa dang 'brel bar byas la phur bu bsdu/ gnyis pa las phur gyis rten gzhi bsgral ba ni/ gdab phur gnyis thogs la/ hūm̐/ rno myur shugs drag phur bu 'di// dgra bgegs spyi bo mgrin pa dang*// snying ga lte ba gsang gnas lngar// gzir zhig badz+ra kī la ya// mig dang rna ba sna dang lce// don lnga snod drug yan lag lnga// sha rus pags pa rtsa rgyus la// gzir zhig badz+ra kī la ya// gzhan yang mdza' bshes gnyen 'khor dpung*// yul 'khor 'bangs dang longs spyod sogs// dgra bgegs sde dang bcas pa la// gzir zhig badz+ra kī la ya// oṃ badz+rā kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad/

ces liṅga'i gnas lnga dbang po lnga rnams su phur bu gdab/ gsum pa sgrol gris snying dum bur bsgral ba ni/ gri thogs la/ hūm̐/ che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// gtum drag rngams pa'i rang bzhin las// yak+ṣa me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs// las byed pho nyar bcas pa rnams// drag po'i phrin las dus la bab// zhing bcu'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi// gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du shig /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor// nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad// ces liṅga dum bur gtub/ bzhi pa tho bas brdung ba ni/ tho ba thogs la/ hūm̐/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams// khro bo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas pas// lha yang rung ste brlag byed na// dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos// oṃ pad+ma a ko ṭa ya kha thaṃ/ zhes brjod cing brdung tshul bya/ lnga pa zhal du bstab pa ni/ ling ro'i cha shas zur du bzhag pa'i 'phros bteg la/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// don snying nang khrol bcas pa rnams// ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// bzhes shig rol cig dgyes par mdzod// māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ zhes sgrub gtor sogs thams cad la brim mo// gnyis pa zlog pa'i las sbyor la lnga/ dang po zlog pa'i dpung bskyed phyir skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bde can 'gyur med kun bzang dbyings// 'og min rnga yab dpal gyi ri// pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas// rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// khrag thung khro bor rnam rol pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor bcas// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// kun bzang 'byor pa rgya mtsho'i dpyid// ngo mtshar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin// phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i// mchod pa kun gyis thugs dam bskang*// me tog spos dang snang gsal dang*// dri chab bshos gtsang rol mo'i sgra// rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga// bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad kyis bskang*// dbang po'i me tog gsur chen spos// zhun mar khrag mkhris byug pa'i mtsho// sha rus tshil bcud thod rnga dang*// rkang gling rol mos thugs dam=

/'chi med bdud rtsi ma da na// dgra bgegs snying khrag 'khrugs pa'i mtsho// dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor ma dang*// bde sbyor bde bas thugs= /rngam brjid dur khrod rol pa'i mkhar// zhing lpags bla bre rgyu rlon gyi// drwa phyed don snying 'phyang 'phrul sogs// drag po'i dkyil 'khor chen pos bskang*// thod skam dbu rgyan zhing lpags gos// mgo phreng sbrul chun stag sham dang*// khrag zhal thal chen rus rgyan sogs// dpal gyi chas gos du mas bskang*// sngags byang glegs bam bgrang phreng dang*// rnga dang rnga chen 'khar rnga dang*// cang te'u dril bu rkang gling dang*// bshug pa'i brda yis thugs= /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// ral gri 'khor lo kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gri gug mdung thung gan+dhe sogs// phyag mtshan mang pos= /sra brtan go dang rno ngar mtshon// mkha' lding bya dang g.yag lug khyu// gcan gzan rngams brjid dpa' bo'i tshogs// 'bum phrag mang pos= /mdzes pa'i rgyan cha dar zab dang*// rin chen sman spos 'bru bcud sogs// mthun pa'i dkor nor dam tshig rdzas// dpag yas nam mkha' gang bas bskang*// ka dag chos skur byang chub gding*// bgegs med dkyil 'khor lhar shar ba'i// ye shes sgyu ma chen po yis// 'khor 'das ro mnyam dbyings su bskang*// med bzhin shar ba'i gzung 'dzin dag /rtogs grol srung zlog bsad pa dang*// mnan sreg 'phang ba'i las sbyor gyis// srid rtsa dbyings su gcod phyir bskang*// zhi dbyings 'gyur med thod phreng rtsal// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis// mngon par byang chub 'bras bu sku// klong du gyur pa'i dgongs pa yis// rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum dang*// yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha// khyad par khrag 'thung thod phreng rtsal// 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// rigs kyi bdag po 'chi med lha// snang ba mtha' yas thugs= /bde gshegs kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon// pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs=

/khrag 'thung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso// dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs= /bde chen ye shes shes rab yum// khros ma nag mo'i thugs= /gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'jigs byed sku// khro rgyal rnam bzhi'i thugs= /tshad med bzhi dngos phrin las mdzod// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs= /gti mug gdon dang dug dbal 'joms// mkha' lding rgyal po'i= /thogs med drag rtsal phrin las bdag /lcags sdig nag po'i= /rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong*// dam can bstan srung thugs dam bskang*// de ltar skong ba'i dam tshig gis// thugs dam gnyen po bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams chag bshags// nyes pa'i sgrib tshogs dag gyur cig /rkyen ngan phyi nang bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// de nas las rdor gyis tshogs bteg la/ hoḥ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod ldan// dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las byung*// tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol// a la la hoḥ zhes slob dpon nas rim bzhin phul te longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus la bzhag gnyis pa zlog pa'i dpung bsdu phyir bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin bla ma rnams// ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bzhengs shig /chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems// ma rungs 'dul mdzad pad+ma saṃ bha ba// 'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad sgyur// zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// hūm̐/ mthu chen myang ral mnga' bdag sras chung zhabs// dam chos rin chen chos nyid rang grol dang*// sangs rgyas lhun grub kun dga' bkra shis mtshan// 'khor bcas khyed kyi sogs tshig rkang bzhi 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ rgyal sras chos rje legs pa dpal bzang dang*// shes rab rgyal mtshan sa lo kun dga'i mtshan// nam mkha'i mtshan can sngags 'chang rat+na'i zhabs// bsod nams dbang po grags pa blo gros sogs// 'khor bcas khyed kyi sogs/

'dul 'dzin mchog gyur ngag dbang chos grags zhabs// bkra shis rin chen spyan ldan kun dga'i mtshan// gnas lnga rig pa kun dga' bsod nams rje// nus mthu'i mnga' bdag bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// 'khor bcas sogs/ bsod nams lhun grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// lhun grub dpal ldan sngags 'chang maṅga'i mtshan// bsod nams rin chen drin can blo gros dang*// dbang sdud snying sogs rim bzhin brgyud pa'i tshogs// 'khor bcas sogs/ hūm̐/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho zhe sdang rkang rus dang*// gti mug sha chen nga rgyal tshwa tshwa g.yeng*// phrag dog rlung nag dgra bgegs 'byung po dang*// 'chi bdag gshin rje 'jig rten dregs pa'i dpung*// dpe dkar srog bdag bsen mo dam sri dang*// sa bdag klu gnyen bdud dang srin po sogs// ma rungs pho mo brdzis pa'i gdan steng na// ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// 'khor bcas sogs/ hūm̐/ khyed kyi spyi gtsug snang ba mtha' yas dang*// phrin las sprul pa bya khyung rgyal po dang*// sku yi sprul pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang*// gsung gi sprul pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dang*// thugs kyi sprul pa phyag na rdo rje dang*// thams cad sprul pa yak+ṣa me dbal sogs// gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs// drag gtum mi bzad thod phreng lha tshogs rnams// 'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad bsgyur// bzlog sgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gsum pa zlog pa'i phrin las bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ ling ro khrag skyems dang sbyar nas zor gtor la rim pas sbron cing*/ hūm̐/ dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang nas// rngams brjid stobs ldan pad+ma he ru ka /thams cad zil gnon srin po'i gdan la bzhengs// chags pa'i skyon spangs pad+ma'i lte ba la// thugs rje rmad byung zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// nyon mongs 'dam skems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar// ma bcos rang byung hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du 'bar// bden pa'i stobs kyis byin rlabs tshwa tshwa 'phro// 'jig rten dregs pa dbang sdud tshar bcad nas// khrag 'thung dbang drag dpal chen sku ru rdzogs// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha lugs gsal bar ldan// brjid la rngams pa'i khro bo g.yul las rgyal// gtum la 'jigs pa'i khrag 'thung he ru ka

/bdud kyi dpung rnams 'joms pa'i mthu stobs can// bgegs dpung 'dul mdzad pad+ma he ru ka /thugs nyid klong yangs 'jig rten lto bar gnas// de las 'das pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams// rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// bsad bcad gtubs te sha khrag rus pa 'cha'// khyod ni dus ngan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan te// bstan la sdang ba thams cad tshar chod cig /bgegs 'dul pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la// dgra bgegs ltas ngan bzlog cing bsgyur du gsol// thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// sku mchog nam mkha'i khongs gang 'jigs pa la// lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mtshan dper ldan// sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// dmar zlum spyan gyi sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs// bar snang khams kyi gdon tshogs brlag par byed// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ag tshom me ltar 'bar// gzi brjid 'od kyis stong gsum ma lus sreg /khros pa'i skan sgras ri rab thang la snyil// rngams pa'i stobs kyis rgya mtsho hub kyis 'dren// thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'gro drug zhal du gsol// rngams brjid pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa sogs tshig rkang gsum 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// chos nyid mi 'gyur phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams// log 'dren tshar gcod phyag g.yon phur bu bsgril// phrin las pho nya gnam lcags sdig pa 'gyed// glang chen zhing dang stag lpags gos su gyon// thod phreng sbrul chun rin chen rus pas brgyan// khrag zhag thal chen byug pa'i rdzas kyis brjid// nyon mongs sreg byed me phung klong na bzhugs// khrag 'thung pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// sku yi gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// srid pa gsum yang zil gyis gnon par byed// gsung gi bzhad sgra rngams pa'i nga ro yis// ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud// thugs nyid byams pa'i thugs rje tshad med pas// 'gro drug ma lus 'khor ba'i gting nas 'dren// ā ra li sogs dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra yis// ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi rngams sgra drag po yis// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad las la 'khol// stobs ldan pad+ma'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sogs/

hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// sku yi cha la 'jam dbyangs sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bo'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs// ya mān+ta ka'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// gsung gi cha la rta mgrin sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bo'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs// ha ya grī wa'i thugs dam dbyings= /dug gsum sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// thugs kyi cha la phyag rdor sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bo'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs// badz+ra pā ṇi'i thugs dam dbyings= /dug gsum sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// phrin las cha las me dbal sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul khro bo'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs// yak+ṣa me dbal thugs dam dbyings= /dug gsum sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// sdigs mdzub rtse las lcags sdig sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul sdig pa'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs// khro rgyal sprul pa'i thugs dam dbyings= /dug gsum sogs/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// thugs kyi rtsal las grangs med sprul pa 'gyed// yang sprul pho nya mang pos stong gsum 'gengs// bka' sdod pho nya'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul// dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la// dgra bgegs ltas ngan zlog cing bsgyur du gsol// thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ hūm̐/ pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal// khyod ni 'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs kyi mchog /bdag gis sgo gsum dad pas khyed bsgrubs nas// dka' ba dang blang lci ba khur du khur// lus srog 'ben btsugs sha khrag gzan du bor// mos gus dad pas khyed la skyabs gsol na// thugs rje ma chung sngon gyi dam bca' dgongs// smon lam las kyis 'brel pa'i mtshams sbyar nas// dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag skyes nas// khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs// bdag cag bla med byang chub sgrub pa yi// lam la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// dbang drag pad+ma 'khor dang bcas pa yis// thugs rje drag po'i stobs kyis bsgral nas kyang*// gru gsum 'bar ba'i zhal gyi hom du drongs// gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan pa'i mgur du chug

/don dam skye med thugs kyi dbyings su stims// rnal 'byor bdag gis dad pas rgyud bskul nas// gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs rnams kyi// bsam ngan sbyor rtsub chag che nyam nga dang*// byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong dang*// than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul gdug rtsub rnams// bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya// bzhi pa 'gal rkyen dmigs pa'i zlog pa ni/ hūm̐/ che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal// khrag 'thung kun gyi 'khor los sgyur// bka' sdod pho nyar bcas pa rnams// da ni zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐/ ma hā de ba lha yi gdon// sgeg pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol// 'chi bdag nag po gshin rje'i gdon// dpa' ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol// khram thogs nad bdag ma mo'i gdon// mi sdug stobs kyis= /nag po bkrag med bdud kyi gdon// dgod pa'i stobs kyis= /gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin gdon// gshe ba'i stobs kyis= /khyab 'jug sgra gcan gza' yi gdon// 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis= /li byin har legs 'gong po'i gdon// snying rje'i stobs kyis= /yam shu dmar po btsan gyi gdon// rngams pa'i stobs kyis= /dga' po 'jog po klu yi gdon// zhi ba'i stobs kyis= /nad mtshon dug sbyar lus kyi gdon// sku yi stobs kyis= /mi kha dmod tshig ngag gi gdon// gsung gi stobs kyis= /bdag 'dzin rnam rtog sems kyi gdon// thugs kyi stobs kyis= /mi mthun ltas ngan cho 'phrul kun// mthu rtsal stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ hūm̐/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// gnod cing bar du gcod pa yi// ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog /ye 'drogs sum brgya drug cu bzlog /dus min 'chi ba 'jigs brgyad bzlog /glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu bzlog

/bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog /gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad= /keg chen sum brgya drug cu= /lha chen drag po'i gdub rtsub= /lha ma yin gyi sgyu thabs= /'gong po'i spar bu bskor ba= /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor bcas pa= /drang srong bram ze'i dmod pa= /gza' yi king kang 'phen pa= /btsan nad gzer kha gtong ba= /sa bdag klu yi mdze nad= /ban+des 'bum skor byed pa= /sngags pa sngags zor 'phen pa= /bon gyis btso dmar 'phen= mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa= /byad phur rbod gtong zug pa= /mnan gtad sreg 'phang byed pa= /mo rtsis rmi lam mtshan ngan= /snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen pa= /phyi zhags gru gur 'thul ba= /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun= /bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog /bsgyur ro drag po'i mthu yis sgyur// zor ro dgra dang bgegs la zor// bcom ldan pad+ma drag po'i tshogs// dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la// byad dang rbod gtong bsgyur ba dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces spyi dang bye brag gi zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ste/ grangs gsog dgos na zlog thung nyid ji ltar 'os pa bskyar/ de nas chos srung gi spyi bstabs byas la lhag ma gtong ba ni/ tshogs lhag slob dpon gyi drung du khyer la/ las kyi rdo rje byed par dbang bskur ba'i// ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging gi tshogs// lhag ma kha chu'i dam la gtogs pa rnams// thugs dam bzhin du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// dam can ma lus rnams 'dir 'dus shig /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sarba ḍā ki nī e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyis chang gi kha phru btab la/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// pad+ma 'byung gnas phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol du// ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs la rol// lhag ma kha chus mi bran du// bran pho bran mo kha chu'i bdag /phud dang lhag ma mi bsre ru// khyod dang ye nas tha tshig gcig

/las rnams rim par mi 'tshol du// las kyi 'dul skal so sor yod// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' bzhin// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes lhag ma dor/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i daṃ puṣ+paṃ nas/ shab+da ma hā pū dza hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs// rnal 'byor sgrub po bdag cag la// zhi bas 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs shig /rgyas pas 'byor drug rgyas pa dang*// mos pas 'gro ba dbang du sdus// drag pos dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// zhes brjod la dngos grub blang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha bskang*/ rten rnams la brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya zhing*/ gtor mgron gyi rten la ma ltos pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la thim/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da de'ang je phra je phrar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ slar yang rang skad cig gis che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis gnas gsum bsrungs la/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/

de nas/ shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i// bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gis bde legs kun stsol ba'i// yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog /'gro ba'i don la mthu ldan pa'i// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bstan pa srung zhing bar chad sel// chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod la bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o// nub tha mar zor 'phen pa la/ gzhan tshang ma gong bzhin la/ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces zlog pa tshar ba'i rjes su/ mchod bstod gong bzhin mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs dang*/ bdag cag las nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// rim gnyis ting 'dzin mi gsal zhing*// bying rgod sems dang ldan gyur pas// sngags kyi bar chad zur nyams pa// cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul sogs// ci mchis thams cad ma hā gu ru// pad+ma thod phreng lha tshogs kyi// spyan sngar bshags shing bzod par gsol// zhes nongs bshags bzod gsol bya/ de nas slob dpon dbang drag gi chas dang*/ rdo rje phur bu thogs la thams cad bzhengs te/ drag po'i zor rdzas 'bar ba rnams// che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// khyung chen snang ba mtha' yas dang*// zhi ba'i las mdzad khrag 'thung ba'i// thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo ni// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang*// rgyas pa'i las mdzad khro rgyal gyi// sku las sprul pa'i khro bo ni// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dang*// dbang gi las mdzad che mchog gi /gsung las sprul pa'i khro bo ni// dbang phyug rta mgrin dpa' bo dang*// drag po'i las mdzad khrag 'thung ba'i// phrin las sprul pa'i khro bo ni// yak+ṣa me dbal drag po dang*// gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bran dang mngag pa shan par bcas// legs par bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i// ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams// dam tshig rten dang bral nas su// bdag gi mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas// legs par bzhugs nas rnal 'byor pa'i// drag po'i las kyi zla grogs mdzod// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces ye shes pa bteg cing zor rdzas rnams dpags la/

zor gtor dam tshig gsal ba rnams// 'od zhu tsha drag 'bar ba yi// dus mtha'i me phung chen po dang*// snang srid phung byed ha la'i sdong*// dal rims gdug pa'i khrag mtsho dang*// ltas ngan yams kyi phung po dang*// shugs drag rdo rje'i mtshon char gyur// bstan la gnod byed bla mar sdang*// sems can la 'tshe bdud kyi dpung*// dam tshig bral ba'i dgra bgegs rnams// ming tsam med par skad cig la// thal bar rlog byed mthu stobs kyis// rab brjid nus pa'i bdag por gyur// de nas dar dmar gyis sna drangs te/ rol mo dang bcas ji ltar rigs pa'i sar khyer la/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma yis// zor chen rdzas kyi nus pa dang*// mthu stobs drag po'i dpung bskyed la// dgra bgegs srog la dbang mdzod cig /de bzhin du tha ma'i tshig rkang gsum spel te/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyis// zor chen sogs/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyis// zor chen sogs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyis// zor chen sogs/ che mchog pad+ma drag po yis// zor chen sogs/ snang mtha' bya khyung rgyal po yis// zor chen sogs/ thugs sprul phyag na rdo rje yis// zor chen sogs/ sku sprul 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis// zor chen sogs/ gsung sprul rta mgrin dpa' bo yis// zor chen sogs/ phrin las yak+ṣa me dbal gyis// zor chen sogs/ bran dang bka' nyan tshogs rnams kyis// zor chen sogs/ sprul pa'i lha dmag tshogs rnams kyis// zor chen sogs/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// zor chen sogs/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// zor chen sogs/ bdag gi gtor zor gnyen po 'di// rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis brlabs// yi dam mkha' 'gros nus pa bskyed// dam can srung mas drag por bsgrubs// sdang byed dgra la 'phen pa'i zor// gnod byed bgegs la 'phen pa'i zor// gdug can thal bar rlog pa'i zor// dam nyams rtsad nas gcod pa'i zor// dgra bo rigs brgyud gcod pa'i zor// sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed pa'i zor// zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la// dgra bgegs srog la dbang mdzod cig

/ces byin bskyed/ de nas kyang cung zad dpags te/ hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po'i nas/ drag gtum mi bzad mjug gi/ zlog sgyur bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod bar gong bzhin bskul/ de nas 'phang ba'i sar sleb pa na/ gser skyems mi dmigs stong par gyur// stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi// thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar// gser skyems dri ro nus ldan gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs la/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs mchod// khyad par pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs mchod// mi mngon byings nas thugs rje yis// nyer dgongs byin rlabs dpal bskyed la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// grub gnyis 'phel par mdzad du gsol// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas// gang gi bstan srung zhal bzhes pa'i// dam can rgya mtsho phud kyis mchod// gdug pa'i sogs 'gre/ bstan pa srung mdzad kun gyi gtso// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral dang*// zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi sogs// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas kun// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// gdug pa'i sogs/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang*// gnas bdag kun dang yul bdag kun// gser skyems= /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// byer dang 'khu ldog ma mdzad par// stong grogs gnyen po ci nus mdzod// sa yi phyogs ni 'di nyid la// sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// 'byung po ma mo gang 'khod pa// thams cad phud kyis tshim gyur nas// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la// ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par// stong grogs gnyen po ci nus mdzod// lha yi phyag rgya mi bzod cing*// byer dang 'khu ldog byed pa rnams// gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas// ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs// zhes tshig mtshams rnams su phud 'thor zhing gser skyems gtong*/

phur pa thogs te/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu nas/ phrin las mdzod bar gong bzhin mnyes pa'i dpang gzugs/ de nas zor la phyogs pas/ hūm̐/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og na// gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs// gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rig 'dzin bdag gi bka' la nyon// dmar chen drag po'i gtor zor 'di// lha srin tshogs la 'phen snyam ste// dkar po'i phyogs la mi 'phen no// khyed rnams rang rang gnas la gshegs// hūm̐/ rnal 'byor zor 'phen gang du 'phen// sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su 'phen// phyogs der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams// sku gzur dbu smod zhabs sdus la// do nub zor gyi zor lam phye// 'khor bcas drag po'i dmag sna drongs// sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su khyer// dpa' bo'i 'khrul 'khor der shoms shig /hūm̐/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir// de ring drag po'i zor 'phen gyi// bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma dang*// sems can phan byed dge la spro// dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi// 'byung po thams cad sku skyod cig /de ring drag po'i sngags kyi zor// sde brgyad rnams la mi 'phen no// ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /lam la gnas pa gzhan du gshegs// gnas gzhan bskyod par ma nus na// mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs skums shig /dma' ba rnams kyi dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams kyi sku gzur zhig /bag med rnams kyi bag mdzod cig /zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la ya// zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la ya// drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa// skad cig tsam la 'grub par mdzod// ces a rtsig ne rtsig 'don cing stangs stabs bcas zor lam dbye/ g.yas g.yon du gtor zor khrag zor thogs la/ hūm̐/ nga ni che mchog thod phreng rtsal// khams gsum kun gyi dbang phyug yin// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud kun// rang rang pho nya'i dmag sdus la// de ring dgra bgegs steng du drongs// rbad do bskul lo dregs pa'i tshogs// grangs med mthu dang dpung bskyed la// dgra bgegs sdig can 'khor bcas kyi// gzugs phung thal ba'i rdul bzhin shig

/rnam shes tshangs pa'i lam nas drongs// rig pa skye med dbyings su spor// dus la bab bo mthu rtsal skyed// ces dang rtsa sngags sham bu can drag tu bzla bzhin pas shar sogs g.yas skor gyi rim pas gtor zor khrag zor nyung zor rnams rgyang du 'phang*/ de nas gtor chen thogs la/ rtsa sngags sham can/ su ma trig rak+ṣa/ bha ya nā sa rnams tshar gsum re'i rjes/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*// sangs rgyas kyi= /chos kyi= /dge 'dun gyi= bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur pa/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= khyad par du yang dregs pa 'dul mdzad che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi= rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin dang chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang*/ khyad par du yang sbyin pa'i bdag po gang yin gyi ming skabs phyed par sbyar te/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad srung ba'i lha dang phrol cig gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig sa'i rten phur phyung zhig

sgyu ma'i lnga phung dkrugs shig zhing gi skye rgyud chod cig yul dang khang khyim shig cig yas kyi pha rgyud chod cig mas kyi bu rgyud chod cig rtsad nas chod cig drung nas phyung zhig glo bur dang ye 'drog thong zhig smyo 'bogs dang brgyal nad thong zhig ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul thong zhig nang mnol dang dme 'khrugs thong zhig lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig zhag dang za ma la rtags mtshan phyung zhig nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin grub pa'i skye shi la khungs ma bcol/ las kyi dbang btsan no zhes tha snyad ma 'dogs par rtags dang mtshan ma myur du mngon du phyung zhig mthu ma chung*/ rtsal ma zhan/ rnal 'byor pas bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzod cig mā ra ya rbad bh+yo zlog ces brjod cing*/ sems kyis gtor chen srid gsum 'joms pa'i nus ldan de nyid dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa 'od kyi rang bzhin de nyid la brgyabs pas mar me la g.yab mo brgyabs pa ltar nag thum gyis shi bar bsam/ dgra bo'i yul ljongs longs spyod thams cad kyang skad cig nyid la rdul phran tsam yang ma lus par brlags par bsams la/ gtor ma kha bub tu drag tu brdab/ dgra bgegs 'khor bcas kyi rnam shes mi bskyod rgyal ba'i zhing du thal gyis song bar bsams te 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bzhag ber phod dang gtor gdan gyi pags pa brdab/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan te phyi mig mi lta bar log srung 'khor dang tshe gzungs 'don/ sgrub khang gi rtsar gtor gzhong sbubs la/ dpon slob rnams srin mdzub sbrel te bskor zhing*/ e ma hoḥ rgyal dbang gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid// ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i sems can gdul ba'i phyir// sna tshogs gzugs dang mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis// las bzhi'i phrin las skyong la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis// 'gro don dpag med mdzad pa'i yi dam lha// nad gdon bar chad zhi zhing tshe dpal rgyas// snod bcud dbang sdus dgra bgegs gzhom par mdzod// rtsa sngags kyi bha ga wa te'i mjug tu shān+tiṃ/

puṣ+ṭiṃ/ ba shaṃ/ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ a ya ma nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces g.yon skor bya/ de nas sgrub khang gi steng du gtor 'bul/ bstan skyong rnams phyag bzhes ltar byas nas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma dang gur zhal las mkhan gyi bkra shis bcas grub nas sgrub khang du 'khod/ tshogs lhag ma gong ltar gtong*/ gsum pa ni/ mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba/ nongs bshags bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs sogs gong du bshad pa ltar bya'o// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs zil// ma nyams drag po'i gtor zlog gis// bstan dgra mthar byed rnal 'byor pa'i// lam gyi bar chad sel gyur cig /ces sgrub thabs rin po che'i zhal skong du dpal sa skya pa 'gro mgon dbang sdud snying po'i gsung ltar blo gter dbang pos bsdebs pa bdag gzhan mtha' dag mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
